biography:
I am Chief of Operations and Dialogue Facilitator at the Civic Science Collective, where I mediate conversations between scientists and citizens on polarizing issues in science and public health. In this role, I have guided dialogues on topics ranging from COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy to trust in Artificial Intelligence.

A former U.S. diplomat, I have extensive experience conducting negotiations and mediations across South America, Asia, and the United States, including during the COVID-19 pandemic in China. 

I hold a Master’s degree from the Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy, where I studied the influence of gender and culture in negotiation and conflict resolution, and where I organized Fletcher's inaugural "Decolonizing International Relations" conference, which brought speakers from the Global South to discuss locally driven approaches to conflict resolution. 

I originally hail from India and currently live in Paraguay. I am closely following developments and governance efforts with frontier AI in both countries.
